'''Kenny Roberts''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 GenCon Team Event]] on 8 August 1999 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base S-Foils]], according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d29">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-03-very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99d29/ very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 3 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-03-very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99d29/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
